raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the local, diurnal sea-breeze cooling effect with the broader climatological impact of prevailing onshore winds. By overemphasizing coastal cooling/marine-layer stability from sea breezes, the Planner ignored that ocean-to-land prevailing winds typically import moist air and enhance precipitation on windward coasts. This led to an incorrect pivot to option C (cold temperatures) despite evidence (e.g., sea-breeze convergence causing showers) supporting A (heavier rainfall) as the most likely outcome.
